titleStmt.title: Certified copy of a report of a committee of the honorable the privy council, approved by his excellency the Governor-General in council on the 3d April, 1884.

div.head: Certified copy of a report of a committee of the honorable the privy council, approved by his excellency the Governor-General in council on the 3d April, 1884.
div.p: On a report dated 27th March, 1884, from the minister of justice, stating that he has had before him a dispatch, dated 7th March instant, from the lieutenant-governor of British Columbia, representing that an outrage was committed at Sumass, in New Westminster district, British Columbia, by persons presumably from the United States of America, taking an Indian prisoner named Lem Tarn from lawful custody and hanging him.

The minister recommends that copies of the dispatch, and of the report of the attorney-general
of British Columbia attached thereto, be transmitted to the British minister at Washington.
The committee respectfully advise that your excellency be moved to transmit the papers above referred to to Her Majesty’s minister at Washington accordingly.

closer.signed:
JOHN J. McGEE,
Cleric Queen’s Privy Council for Canada.
